title: Bomar Builders' 15K-SF Las Olas spec megamansion lists for $100M, Broward's priciest
summary: A proposed 15,185-SF estate at 708 Royal Plaza Drive in Fort Lauderdale hit the market at $100M, the most expensive listing in Broward County per Zillow, or $6,585 per SF if built as designed. The 0.92-acre lot has 548 feet of water frontage. Heather Lefka of Florida Luxurious Properties holds the listing; the land may be sold separately. It tops an $80M Riviera Isle proposal listed in July.

title: Charles Cohen lands $385M in construction debt for West Palm Point office tower
summary: Cohen Brothers Realty secured $385M ($350M plus $35M) for West Palm Point, a 23-story, 438,000-SF, $400M office building at 850 S. Quadrille Blvd in downtown West Palm Beach. Cooper Horowitz's Robert Horowitz arranged the debt; lenders were not disclosed. Construction has started, with completion expected in Q1 2029 after the city extended the deadline to January 2029.

title: Industrial equipment exec pays $71M off-market for Naples Gordon Drive estate
summary: Douglas Schumann of P-Q Controls paid $69.4M for the 9,550-SF property at 2050 Gordon Drive plus $1.6M for furnishings, about $7,435 per SF. The seller was a trust tied to Culligan International's Scott Gibbs Clawson. The sale came about $4M under the $75M private ask, and the site last traded for $30M in 2022. Compass says it is its highest-priced Florida deal this year.

title: Faena Residences Miami closes $817M Tyko loan, Florida's largest condo construction loan
summary: Fortune International Group and KAR Properties closed an $817M construction loan from Tyko Capital for the 440-unit, two-tower Faena Residences Miami at 24 SW Fourth Street on the Miami River. Walker & Dunlop arranged the financing, which the developers say is the largest condo construction loan in Florida history. Completion is expected in early 2030, with more than $500M in presales reported.

title: Driftwood, Merrimac, MV score $145M Centennial Bank loan for Miami Riverside Wharf
summary: The developers of the $350M Riverside Wharf at 114 SW North River Drive secured $145M in construction financing from Centennial Bank. The 200,000 SF, nine-story, two-tower project will include a 167-room Dream Hotel, a 30,000 SF nightclub, a 12,000 SF event hall and 16,000 SF of restaurant space. Completion is targeted for fall 2028.

title: Glaser, Edelstein under contract at $160M for Palm Beach teardown estate
summary: Developers Todd Glaser and TriCap's David Edelstein are under contract to pay $160M for 911 North Ocean Boulevard, per the Wall Street Journal. That is just under the island's $170M record set in 2023. The 2.2-acre site has 250 feet of ocean frontage and about 17,600 SF of 1970s buildings, or roughly $9,100 per SF. The family listed it at $185M last year; the buyers plan to split it into two lots.

title: Fortune, Château land $463M Madison Realty loan for St. Regis Sunny Isles
summary: Madison Realty Capital is providing a $463M loan package for the two-tower St. Regis Residences at 18801 Collins Avenue, one of the largest loans to close in Sunny Isles Beach. It refinances existing debt, including Bank OZK loans from 2020. The project is 80% presold; the south tower (150 units) is under vertical construction and the north tower (170 units) is next. Remaining units start at $5.1M.

title: LeCesse pays $18M for Deerfield Beach site entitled for 237 apartments
summary: LeCesse Development bought the 4.3-acre site at 201-299 North Federal Highway for $18M, or $4.2M per acre, from entities tied to Brefrank Enterprises and Centrum. CIBC Bank USA provided an $11.3M mortgage. The plan is a five-story, 237-unit building with a 452-space garage. The sellers assembled the site for $8.6M between 2017 and 2021, and the city is weighing looser development rules.

title: Golden East buys One Boca Place office complex from CP Group for $78.9M
summary: New York-based Golden East Investors paid $78.9M, about $283 per SF, for the 278,000-SF One Boca Place at 2255 West Glades Road in Boca Raton, its first Florida purchase. City National Bank of Florida provided an $82.1M loan. CP Group paid $76.4M in 2014 and remains property manager. It is CP's third big Boca office sale in recent weeks, after the Boca Raton Innovation Campus and Two Town Center. Asking rent is $52/SF.

title: Lennar revealed as buyer of 91-acre Boynton Beach Mall site
summary: Lennar is buying the Boynton Beach Mall at 801 North Congress Avenue from Washington Prime Group, with plans for townhomes and some commercial space, per the Palm Beach Post as cited by The Real Deal. The 91-acre site has approval for 1,700 housing units. The mall is expected to close Jan. 15. JCPenney, Cinemark and Christ Fellowship Church own their buildings, which are not part of the sale.

title: Genting's Resorts World lands $500M refinance on downtown Miami Hilton and Omni Center
summary: Property records show Wells Fargo as mortgagee, representing a group of lenders, on a $500M refinance for Resorts World Omni's downtown Miami holdings, anchored by the 527-room Hilton Miami Downtown at 1601 Biscayne Boulevard. A Genting affiliate bought the site via foreclosure in 2011 for $180M. Genting has long sought a downtown casino license.

title: Grover Corlew buys 200 E. Broward Blvd office tower for $69.7M, 14% below 2017 price
summary: Boca-based Grover Corlew paid $69.7M, about $296 per SF, for the 235,110-SF, 21-story 200 East Broward Boulevard in downtown Fort Lauderdale. Sellers Banyan Street and Oaktree paid $81.5M in 2017. BridgeInvest provided a $63.4M loan, and the buyer plans $20M of renovations. Office space is listed at $44/SF; JLL says Fort Lauderdale demand picked up slightly in the third quarter.

title: TriCap asks $100M for 800 Lincoln Road retail building in Miami Beach
summary: Newmark is marketing the 32,100-SF, three-story 800 Lincoln Road, home to Lululemon and Mila, at a $100M ask, or $3,111 per SF. TriCap paid $88.2M ($2,744 per SF) in 2015 and redeveloped the building. Nearby, 930 Lincoln Road sold for $22M last week and 318-334 Lincoln Road for $18.4M last month.

title: AHPC buys 1,086-bed FIU-area student housing from Toll Brothers for $168.5M
summary: Nonprofit Affordable Housing Preservation Corp. bought the 21-story, 293-unit Lapis in Sweetwater for $168.5M, or $575,085 per unit, financed with about $193.9M of Public Finance Authority bonds. AHPC will operate it as student, faculty and staff housing and transfer it to FIU once the bonds are repaid. Toll Brothers completed the building in 2023.

title: Billionaire VC Hemant Taneja linked to record $48.5M Venetian Islands mansion
summary: Hemant Taneja, CEO of General Catalyst, is the buyer of a 10,700-SF waterfront estate on North Venetian Way, San Marco Island, per The Real Deal. The $48.5M sale topped the $47.5M ask and set a record for the Venetian Islands and San Marco. The seven-bedroom house sits on 0.3 acre with 103 feet of water frontage; sellers paid $6M in 2021. Furniture was included.

title: Top deals: 100-year-old Palm Island mansion sells for $29M; West Palm warehouse $27.5M
summary: TRD's Oct. 14 digest: an 11,300-SF Palm Island mansion at 49 Palm Avenue in Miami Beach traded for $29M ($2,565/SF), last sold for $4.9M in 2004, with a $27.7M JPMorgan Chase mortgage. Meso Scale Diagnostics paid $27.5M ($327/SF) for an 84,000-SF West Palm Beach warehouse, and a Rivo Alto Island home sold for $17.2M ($3,406/SF).
